scope: Public-source bindings for SIG/TJIG and named operators/facilities. These records bind an entity to an airport/ramp address only where supported; they do not prove that a screenshot POI pin identifies a specific building polygon or landing surface.

bindings.subject: SIG_TJIG
bindings.object: Fernando Luis Ribas Dominicci Airport / Isla Grande Airport
assertions: SIG/TJIG is Fernando Luis Ribas Dominicci Airport, also known as Isla Grande Airport
FBO ramps, services and facilities are on both sides of the runway
airport supports air-taxi and military helicopter operations
does_not_prove: identity of any individual screenshot hangar
existence of an uncharted dedicated helipad
operator of the screenshot marked-H pad

bindings.subject: Benitez Aviation Inc
bindings.object: PRFBO-1 Muelle Panamericano, Rampa Norte Hangar A, Isla Grande, San Juan
assertions: FAA aircraft registration for N196DM lists Benitez Aviation Inc as registered owner
registered owner street address identifies North Ramp Hangar A at Isla Grande
does_not_prove: that a Google Maps pin centroid equals the Hangar A footprint
that every aircraft visible in the screenshot belongs to Benitez

bindings.subject: Modern Aviation
bindings.object: Fernando Luis Ribas Dominicci Airport / TJIG
assertions: Modern Aviation announced acquisition of Puerto Rico FBO LLC at TJIG in 2024
Benitez Aviation continued its aircraft-management and Part 135 charter business at the airport
does_not_prove: which exact screenshot building polygon is owned or leased by Modern Aviation
dedicated helipad existence on either pictured Modern apron

bindings.subject: Planet Air Aviation
bindings.object: Isla Grande Airport, South Ramp Lot 2A, San Juan PR 00907
assertions: Planet Air Aviation is listed at Isla Grande Airport South Ramp Lot 2A
listed activity includes helicopter tours and charter services
does_not_prove: exact building footprint from the screenshot pin
ownership or operation of the marked-H pad

bindings.subject: Life Flight of Puerto Rico Inc
bindings.object: Via Principal Hangar #4 Sur, Isla Grande Airport, San Juan PR 00907
assertions: NPPES-derived listing reports an Isla Grande South Hangar #4 address

identity_rule: Airport/ramp/address binding is not building-polygon identity. Exact tenant-to-footprint promotion requires an authoritative lease/site plan, certified geometry plus independent alias/ID evidence, or equivalent stronger evidence.
